_about: Parameters loaded by the wifi-csi-sensing explorers. Entries with class public or illustrative are copied verbatim from ../constants.json. Entries with class assumption are model choices made by one explorer page to build its synthetic signal; they are not from any study and not measurements.

wavelength_5g.source: my arithmetic: speed_of_light / 5.5 GHz (mid 5 GHz band)

link_length_illustrative.source: round room-scale link length used for the Fresnel example in A1

fresnel_first_zone_mid_radius_example.source: my arithmetic: r1 = 0.5 x sqrt(lambda x d) at the midpoint of a link of illustrative length d = 4 m (link_length_illustrative); formula from Fresnel-zone model, Wang et al. UbiComp 2016

delay_resolution_by_width.unit: ns and metres of path length
delay_resolution_by_width.source: my arithmetic: delay resolution = 1/bandwidth; path = speed_of_light x delay

doppler_walk_example_5g.source: my arithmetic: reflected path length changes at up to 2 x 1 m/s for an illustrative 1 m/s walk; f = 2 / wavelength_5g

beacon_rate_default.source: my arithmetic from beacon_interval_default: 1 / (100 x 1024 us)

csi_rate_beacon_illustrative.source: round value for passive beacon-driven CSI; consistent with beacon_rate_default; internal I2/I7 report the same order

csi_rate_injected_illustrative.source: round nominal rate with injected traffic (pings or test frames); internal I7 reports the same order

near_device_radius_illustrative.source: illustrative 'near a device' radius in the scenario script; internal I3

room_width_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 01: a 6 m wide synthetic room around the link (my simplification; not from any study)

room_margin_assumption.unit: m (room extends this far beyond each radio)
room_margin_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 01 (my simplification)

wall_reflectivity_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 01: one first-order reflection per wall, image method (my simplification of A1's multipath sum)

window_short_illustrative.source: round analysis window used in early single-link work; internal I1/I2

window_long_illustrative.source: round analysis window used in later feature studies; internal I7

false_alarm_budget_illustrative.unit: false alarms per home per month
false_alarm_budget_illustrative.source: illustrative product-level false-alarm budget; internal I7

acf_vs_variance_illustrative.source: illustrative gap between a self-normalised ACF feature and raw variance; internal I7

window_4s_vs_8s_gain_illustrative.source: illustrative: doubling the window adds about one point; internal I7

stream_length_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 02: length of the synthetic scripted stream

stream_subcarriers_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 02: a reduced subcarrier set after selection (B1 keeps a fraction); kept small so the page stays fast

hop_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 02: sliding-window hop (B3 sliding windows)

scatterers_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 02: body as several scatterers with radial speeds spread up to the walking speed (my simplification of A1's Doppler bound)

fan_rate_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 02: fluctuation rate of a fan (inanimate motion, C5)

single_link_range_illustrative.unit: m from the line of sight
single_link_range_illustrative.source: illustrative distance beyond which walking motion is hard to see on one link; internal I1 reports the same order

devices_tpr_illustrative.source: illustrative relation: more endpoints help, device-to-device links help more; internal I7

device_spacing_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 03: both devices at the link_length_illustrative distance from the AP, at right angles

link_body_weight_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 03: weight of motion along a link body versus near its ends (A1: middle less sensitive than ends)

wall_attenuation_assumption.source: page model choice for explorer 03: a wall between the motion and the links scales its effect (B4 through-wall)
